title: fix(plugin-form): the record drawer opens on its first field, not on Close (objectui#13219)
body:
Fixes #13219

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`DrawerForm` (`packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx`) now calls `useInitialFieldFocus()` and hands its `onOpenAutoFocus` / `onCloseAutoFocus` pair to the `SheetContent` it opens, exactly as `ModalForm` does since objectui#13130 (`9eb1479`). The record drawer now opens on its first editable field once the body loads; while the body loads the sheet panel itself holds focus; a control the user reached in the meantime keeps focus. `initialFieldFocus.ts` is unchanged: the drawer needed nothing the modal did not.

This is the drawer half of objectui#13130's defect class; that card kept the modal half and the skip link.

## The producer, measured on unfixed main (`58798ec`)

`DrawerForm` opens its `SheetContent` before its body exists: the object schema (and on edit the record) are read after the sheet mounts, and the footer is drawn only once the load ends. Radix's focus scope focuses the first tabbable element at mount, which is the sheet's Close button (`absolute right-4 top-4`), and it kept focus once the fields arrived. The new test file run against the unfixed tree:

```
× create: focus lands on the first field once the body has loaded
× edit: focus lands on the first field once the record has loaded
× DrawerForm mounted directly (no ObjectForm routing) opens on its first field too
× while the body loads, the sheet itself holds focus (named by its title), not Close
× skips a field the user cannot edit: a read-only first field leaves focus to the next one
× the subforms (master-detail) arm opens on its first header field too
Tests  6 failed | 1 passed (7)
```

Five cases read `document.activeElement` as the sheet's Close button; the subforms (master-detail) arm read it as the master-detail Cancel button (`data-testid="md-form-cancel"`), the first tabbable element in the sheet at mount on that arm. The one case green on both legs is "a control focused while the body loads keeps it": it guards the fix against stealing focus back, so it cannot fail without the fix.

## Mechanism assumptions, each measured

1. The body draws after the content mounts, so the focus scope picks Close: confirmed by the red run above.
2. `useInitialFieldFocus` works unchanged on a Sheet: `SheetContent` (`packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx`) spreads its remaining props onto Radix's Dialog `Content`, so the pair reaches Radix without touching `packages/components`, and `event.currentTarget` is the sheet content: the "while the body loads" case reads `document.activeElement` as the `role="dialog"` element.
3. The drawer's field rows carry `[data-field]`: the subforms case asserts the focused input's row is `[data-field="title"]`, and every create/edit case lands on the first editable input.

## Tests

New: `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/drawerInitialFieldFocus-13219.test.tsx` (7 cases), modelled on `modalInitialFieldFocus-13130.test.tsx`: create and edit through `ObjectForm` (`formType: 'drawer'`), one mounting `DrawerForm` directly, the loading window held open by hand, the user-reached control, a read-only first field, and the subforms arm.

- With the fix: `pnpm exec vitest run` on the new file plus `modalInitialFieldFocus-13130.test.tsx`: `Tests  18 passed (18)`.
- Ablation (the pair dropped from `SheetContent`, fix committed first, through `ablation-replace.mjs`): anchor 1 to 0, blob `c60ddf25d4e8` to `841e319d1a34`; `Tests  6 failed | 1 passed (7)`, the same six as unfixed main; restored, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Whole package at `b50c927`: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files  197 passed (197)`, `Tests  2367 passed | 1 skipped (2368)`.
- Downstream importers that render the drawer path (app-shell `PageView.test.tsx`, plugin-designer `MetadataFieldsPage.refusalIssues-11302` and `FieldDesigner.choiceTypesHidden-11253`, plugin-view `ObjectView.drawerDirection-11775` and `ObjectView.formTitleI18n`, `examples/schema-catalog` `catalog-gallery-render`): `Test Files  6 passed (6)`, `Tests  622 passed (622)`. No export, prop or type changes, so these were a behaviour check, not owed.

## Gates (local, head `b50c927`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` on the test project lists the new file): exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, "2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, "0 new citation(s)".
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched source files: 0 errors; `DrawerForm.tsx` carries the same 21 warnings as on main, none on a touched line.

Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## Browser reading notes

- First field of the showcase task form view `quick` (`type: 'drawer'`, sections `quick_edit`: `status`, `priority`, `progress`): `[role="dialog"] [data-field="status"] [role="combobox"]` (the select field's trigger).
- Read from source, not in a browser: no console route found mounts `DrawerForm` for a form view. `/forms/NAME` renders the view through the console's own inline form (`FormPage`); record New/Edit opens `ModalForm` (`AppContent`); the object view's `navigation.mode: 'drawer'` draws its own `Sheet` around an `ObjectForm` it builds with no `formType` (plugin-view `ObjectView`, `renderDrawerForm`). `DrawerForm` is reached through an `object-form` node with `formType: 'drawer'`, the shape `@objectstack/spec`'s `react-blocks.ts` declares for a page block; no showcase page found authors one. A browser reading therefore needs such a block on a page.

## Acceptance notes

- `initialFieldFocus.ts`'s header still describes the record dialog only; it now serves the drawer too. Left unchanged per the claim's file surface (no behaviour needed it).
- Unmeasured observation, not filed: plugin-view `ObjectView`'s `renderDrawerForm` opens its own `SheetContent` around an `ObjectForm` whose body also loads after mount, without this pair. Read from source only; no reproduction ran, and whether a console route reaches that surface was not measured. Carrier: none.
